title: Tan floppy dog — deep clean and restuff
description: This 20+ year old tan floppy-eared plush dog arrived flat and tired — we opened the back seam, deep cleaned the plush, and restuffed him so he sits plump and even again.
itemDetails: This floppy tan puppy with chocolate-brown ears and a matching dark-brown tail matches the look of Ty Beanie Buddy Bones, the larger plush companion to the classic Beanie Baby of the same name. Ty released the Buddy version in June 2000 and retired it in April 2002; the original Beanie Baby Bones ran much longer from the mid-1990s. Typical features are a light-tan polyester plush body, darker brown floppy ears and tail, small bead or button eyes, and a simple sitting puppy silhouette aimed at cuddle play rather than a stiff collector pose. A tush tag is present on this example but was not readable in the photos, so the brand is identified from construction and colouring rather than a confirmed label.
repairDetails: This plush dog is more than twenty years old and had gone flat from years of hugs, with tired fill and a dull, soiled pile. We opened the back seam, emptied the old stuffing, and deep cleaned the tan body and brown ears. Fresh fill was worked through the head, body, and limbs so the puppy sits evenly again, then the seam was closed.
